transcript: can i return a shirt if i don't like it
response:
Hello! I am ZentroMart's AI customer support assistant. 

Yes, you can return a shirt if you don't like it, as long as it is within the return window. 

Here are the details for returning a clothing item:
* **Return Window:** You have 15 calendar days from the delivery date to return it.
* **What you can do:** You can either request a return for a refund, or you can exchange it for a different size or colour (subject to stock availability). If the new size or colour is out of stock, a return and refund will be offered instead.

document_evidence.title: Frequently asked questions
document_evidence.section: [FAQ-2] Can I return something I bought?
document_evidence.text: Most items can be returned within the return window. Some items, like grocery, cannot be returned.

document_evidence.title: Cancellations policy
document_evidence.text:
A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can:
- refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or
- accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable.

document_evidence.title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
document_evidence.text: Reports after 48 hours are handled as a normal return if the item is still within its return window. Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any.

document_evidence.title: Delivery and shipping policy
document_evidence.text: The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. After a failed attempt the customer gets an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO) and REF-1 applies.

document_evidence.title: Returns policy
document_evidence.text: Exchanges for a different size or colour are available on clothing and footwear within the return window, subject to stock. If the new size is out of stock, a return and refund is offered instead.

document_evidence.title: Returns policy
document_evidence.text:
The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog.

| Category | Return window | Catalog code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electronics and accessories | 7 days | `electronics` |
| Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` |
| Home, kitchen and furniture | 10 days | `home_kitchen` |
| Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` |
| Books and stationery | 10 days | `books_media` |
| Grocery, fresh and perishables | Not returnable | `grocery` |
| Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` |
| Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` |
